entries.title: Book VI: The Brain
entries.content:
"Der Körper ist das Instrument des Geistes."
(The body is the instrument of the mind.)

entries.title: Book VI: The Brain
entries.content: The focus moves inward. The brain is described in structure, and the cranial nerves traced outward into the body.

entries.title: Book VI: The Brain
entries.content: Where earlier thinkers placed mental faculties within unseen spaces, Vesalius holds back. He describes what he sees—and avoids claiming more than he can observe.

entries.title: Book VI: The Brain
entries.content: The brain becomes something to be understood, not assumed.
